To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

packaging design elements can be used to construct brand identity, and that the use of packaging elements to construct brand identity is more effective when the packaging design elements are matched to the product category.

Packaging design elements that are congruent with the product category’s brand personality are perceived to be more authentic and more appropriate than incongruent packaging design elements, and congruent packaging design elements evoke more favorable brand personality impressions than incongruent design elements.

(1) packaging design elements are associated with brand personality dimensions; (2) packaging design elements vary by product category; (3) the association between packaging design elements and brand personality varies by product category.
